text: {"lessons":["I sold several stocks for gains quickly, then repurchased Stock B at a much higher price and eventually sold it at a steep loss; I should avoid chasing prices and use consistent, forward-looking criteria for both buying and selling.","My reluctance to admit a mistake can keep me tied to a losing position. I should reassess a stock on its current outlook, not its average cost, and set a clear risk limit before investing.","Repeated trades in individual stocks can obscure the health of the whole account. I should review portfolio concentration and risk together, rather than treating each stock as a separate account."]}
